headline: Operations Analyst | Reporting and Dashboards | Process Improvement
summary: Operations analyst who turns manual spreadsheets and handoffs into reliable reporting and workflow systems. Built a SQL-backed dashboard that cut weekly report prep from about 6 hours to under 1, and shortened claim resolution from 14 to 9 days by mapping the process across teams. Comfortable translating between frontline teams and technical stakeholders.

bullets.text: Rebuilt the weekly carrier-performance report from four manual spreadsheets into one SQL-backed Looker dashboard, cutting prep time from about 6 hours to under 1 hour a week.
Mapped the damaged-shipment claims process with customer service and finance, reducing average claim resolution from 14 days to 9.
Own data quality checks for 2,000+ weekly shipments and flag anomalies to dispatch leads.
Run weekly performance reviews with 8 regional carriers using the new dashboard.
Trained 12 dispatchers on the new dashboard and wrote the internal how-to guide.
Resolved 60+ Zendesk tickets a day across orders, billing, and delivery with CSAT above 94%.
Built a library of 40+ saved-reply macros that the team adopted as its standard.
Tagged ticket drivers monthly; the top-three driver report fed product roadmap reviews.
Scheduled 15 student workers across three service desks each semester.
Tracked loans for 300+ laptops and hotspots during remote learning.
Managed a $12K annual budget and ran reimbursement for 20+ events.
